summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing for Café Komorebi reservation system. Backend: 28/28 pytest tests pass (auth, availability, reservation flow with mock pay, special-occasion/large-group needs_approval, admin approve/reject, tables status, blocks affecting availability, holidays, owner-only settings/users/tables, analytics, waitlist, RBAC). Frontend: customer register/login, booking date/slot selection, policies-required error toast, pay -> on-screen confirmation, admin dashboard tabs (overview/pending/waitlist/reservations/tables/availability), owner exclusive settings tab with save-settings/add-staff/add-table all render; RBAC: admin does NOT see owner-only Settings tab.

minor.issue: Email is silently lowercased by server; documented behavior but test needed adjustment

issues: Radix DialogContent missing DialogTitle / aria-describedby -> a11y console warnings on /book (confirmation modal). Wrap title in VisuallyHidden or add DialogTitle/Description.

action_items: (Optional) Add DialogTitle + DialogDescription (or VisuallyHidden wrapper) to the payment confirmation Dialog on /book to remove Radix a11y warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_booking_window uses ref.date() with UTC — may cause off-by-one for users in IST when clock crosses midnight; consider a fixed 'cafe' timezone.
clean_reservation() is reused for tables/blocks/holidays/waitlist which just strips _id and adds id — misleading name; rename to _strip_id or similar for clarity.
generate_slots uses hold_minutes (default 90) as the required slot duration, meaning last valid slot on Tue-Fri evening is 20:30 (last table seat until 22:00). Confirm this matches product spec.
delete_user route allows deleting ANY user including seeded admin/owner; consider protecting seeded staff accounts.
No index on reservations.date/status which is queried often; consider adding compound indexes for scale.
CORS_ORIGINS is '*' with allow_credentials=True; browsers will reject credentialed requests with wildcard. Not currently used (JWT via header) but risky if cookie auth is added.
Availability endpoint is unauthenticated — could be abused for scraping; not critical for MVP.
seed_data_creation: Test users with TEST_ prefix and TEST_Table were created and cleaned up in tests. Two live reservations (TEST Bday confirmed, Test Booker confirmed for today) remain in DB from playwright UI test — harmless demo data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py is a full pytest suite (junitxml at /app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml). Booking flow requires selecting a date within /api/booking-window range and a non-Monday day. Razorpay is fully mocked. Guest user's My Reservations may not show a Cancel button if the corresponding booking's status is not in the cancellable set; earlier iteration tests may have already cancelled them.
